depends_on: Dirichlet: sum 1/p diverges over p = 1 mod 4 and over p = 3 mod 4
sieve bound: integers avoiding a prime set with divergent reciprocal sum have density 0
category_override: answered elsewhere; confirmed or written up here
notes: Known: Grau and Oller-Marcen, arXiv:1304.2678, Prop. 12 (characterisation: k > 2 is a term iff k odd with all prime factors sharing v2(p-1), or k = 4m, 8m, m > 3 odd with all prime factors 3 mod 4) and Prop. 13 (density zero). Re-derived by CRT and local power sums; characterisation checked against direct sums for k <= 6000. Outside Lean: the whole argument (local power sums, Dirichlet divergence, sieve density).

sources.cite: J. M. Grau, A. M. Oller-Marcen, About the congruence sum k^f(n) = 0 (mod n), arXiv:1304.2678 (2013), Prop. 12-13
